symptom: The authenticated production business-performance page on public version 574 shows 'לא הצלחנו לטעון את הדוח', and its days=30 API returns 503 business_performance_unavailable.
expected_behavior: An authorized administrator receives the aggregate 30-day business funnel from Aurora without exposing raw contacts or credentials.
environment: https://vii.spaplus.co public version 574, source 7215b55156c9804bb4af7ac83055f4a1b6e262ec, observed 2026-10-22 Israel time; repair applied to the local release candidate after c121f38ad27a047cc60d0e861629a6c80b9cb692.

steps: Read /api/admin/business-performance?days=30 in the same authorized session.
reproduction.evidence: The page rendered its recovery state and the API returned {"error":"business_performance_unavailable"} with HTTP 503.

observations.observation: The failing query used SUM(name='...') for five counters.
The authenticated backend-readiness route succeeded against Aurora and reported vii_business_events with 4111 rows.
The working admin overview already uses portable SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) expressions.

hypotheses.mechanism: The report retained a SQLite boolean-sum expression after the read path moved to Aurora PostgreSQL.
hypotheses.prediction: The report alone fails while another aggregate route using CASE WHEN and the same Aurora table succeeds; replacing boolean sums with CASE WHEN restores a portable query.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the report SQL with the working overview SQL, apply the portable aggregate, run focused admin/Aurora tests and TypeScript.
hypotheses.result: The report was the only SUM(name=...) occurrence; after replacement, 14 focused tests and TypeScript passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: Aurora or the vii_business_events table is unavailable.
hypotheses.prediction: Backend readiness and other reads of vii_business_events would fail or report no table.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Read authenticated production backend readiness and inspect table metadata.
hypotheses.result: Aurora readiness succeeded and reported the table with 4111 rows, so general database unavailability does not explain the route-specific failure.

fix.change: Replace all five SUM(boolean predicate) expressions with SUM(CASE WHEN predicate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), matching the already working overview route.
fix.evidence: tests/admin-command-center.test.mjs now enforces the portable expression and rejects SUM(name=...); focused tests and pnpm exec tsc --noEmit passed.

regression_checks.check: Admin overview authorization and route contract

remaining_unknowns: The fix is not yet public because the next Sites deployment remains blocked before build by external npm/pnpm retrieval failures; public 574 still shows the error.
authorization_boundary: Read-only production diagnosis and local repair were authorized. No raw contact data, payment, DNS, destructive database operation or credential change was performed.
